purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18903 with one node:test case each in test/discovery/journey-check.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-212) removes the flags as it makes them pass.
title: US-18903 UX intake gate suite (journey-check)

testCases.description: [happy] Given a declared light or central product with a journey, when the journey check verb runs, then it evaluates discovery:journeyPresent (at least one journey with an entry and an exit), discovery:stepsNameScreens (every JourneyStep.screenId resolves), discovery:reachable (every step reachable from an entry and every non-exit step with a next or a returnsTo) and discovery:interruptions, prints one line per check, and exits 0 when every check passes.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-check.test.js::AC-18903-1 happy: a declared light or central product with a journ

testCases.description: [happy] Given the interruption catalogue [lostEmail | closedTab | deadBattery | expiredLink | switchedDevice | lostSignal], when discovery:interruptions evaluates a journey, then each catalogue entry is either mapped to an interruption step of that journey or ruled out as notApplicable with a reason of at least 20 characters, and an entry that is neither fails the check with an id naming the journey and the entry.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-check.test.js::AC-18903-2 happy: the interruption catalogue lostemail closedtab d

testCases.description: [happy] Given a central product, when discovery:wireframePerStep evaluates, then it fails for every step whose Screen.wireframe is null or does not resolve on disk, and given a light product the same check reports notApplicable and never fails for a missing wireframe.

[happy] Given a wireframe file, when the check reads it, then a .md or .png file is accepted as-is, an .html file is accepted when it carries no href or src whose value starts http:, https: or //, and the file's bytes are hashed with sha256 without any inspection of its headings or sections.

[failure] Given an .html wireframe carrying an external stylesheet, script, image or font URL, when the journey check verb runs, then discovery:wireframeSelfContained fails naming the file and the first offending URL and the verb exits 4.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-check.test.js::AC-18903-5 failure: an html wireframe carrying an external styleshee

testCases.description: [edge] Given a journey with a non-exit step that has no next and no returnsTo, when discovery:reachable evaluates, then it fails naming that step as a dead end, distinct from the why it gives a step no entry reaches.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-check.test.js::AC-18903-6 edge: a journey with a nonexit step that has no next a

testCases.description: [must-not] Given a declared none product or a tree with no journey.json, when the journey check verb runs, then it reports notApplicable with the reason, reads no wireframe file, and exits 0.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/journey-check.test.js::AC-18903-7 must-not: a declared none product or a tree with no journe
